paragraphs: It was eight o'clock on Thursday evening. Lily answered the phone in the kitchen. "Hello, this is Lily," she said. "Hello, Lily. This is Teacher Nick from Tom's school," said a man. "Is your mom at home?" "Yes, but she is in the shower," said Lily. "Can I take a message?" "Yes, please," said Teacher Nick. "I have something to tell Tom."

"The football game is not on Friday," he said. "The field is not dry, because it rained all week." "The game is on Saturday at half past nine." "The weather is better on Saturday." Lily wrote on the paper by the phone, "Saturday, half past nine." "Most of the boys can come," said Teacher Nick. "Can Tom come too?" "Wait, please," said Lily. Tom was awake in his room, and she ran to him. "Yes, I can come!" said Tom.

Lily came back to the phone. "Tom says yes," she said. "Good. Please write my number for your mom," said Teacher Nick. "Zero, eight, two, six, one, nine, nine, four, four, seven." Lily wrote the number on the paper and read it back. "There is a new boy in Tom's class," said Teacher Nick. "His name is Hugo, and he is good at football." "Please ask Tom to play with him." "OK!" said Lily. "Goodbye, Teacher Nick." Mom came out of the shower and put the paper next to the phone. Later, Tom looked at it and smiled.
text.summary: Teacher Nick calls on Thursday evening, and Lily answers. The football game is on Saturday, and he gives his number and a message about a new boy.

sentences.text: It was eight o'clock on Thursday evening.
Lily answered the phone in the kitchen.
"Hello, this is Lily," she said.
"Hello, Lily. This is Teacher Nick from Tom's school," said a man.
"Is your mom at home?"
"Yes, but she is in the shower," said Lily.
"Can I take a message?"
"Yes, please," said Teacher Nick.
"I have something to tell Tom."
"The football game is not on Friday," he said.
"The field is not dry, because it rained all week."
"The game is on Saturday at half past nine."
"The weather is better on Saturday."
Lily wrote on the paper by the phone, "Saturday, half past nine."
"Most of the boys can come," said Teacher Nick.
"Can Tom come too?"
"Wait, please," said Lily.
Tom was awake in his room, and she ran to him.
"Yes, I can come!" said Tom.
Lily came back to the phone.
"Tom says yes," she said.
"Good. Please write my number for your mom," said Teacher Nick.
"Zero, eight, two, six, one, nine, nine, four, four, seven."
Lily wrote the number on the paper and read it back.
"There is a new boy in Tom's class," said Teacher Nick.
"His name is Hugo, and he is good at football."
"Please ask Tom to play with him."
"OK!" said Lily.
"Goodbye, Teacher Nick."
Mom came out of the shower and put the paper next to the phone.
Later, Tom looked at it and smiled.
